name: Ganesh
player_statement:
A complete player, Ganesh has made a big mark in cricket. With 58 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 34*, with an average of 11.06 and a quick strike rate of 96.37. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 27 sixes and 13 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 11.5 overs, taking 4 wickets at an economy rate of 9.46. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
